items.source: 100% stripped of footsteps, weather, swimming, flight, loot, quest, and UI noise
items.target: 100% stripped（完全过滤）脚步声、天气、游泳、飞行、拾取、任务和界面杂音

items.source: A bright tick when something you could interact with — an NPC, a node, a door — comes under your reticle.
items.target: 当可交互对象（NPC、采集点、门等）进入你的准星时，产生清脆的提示震动。

items.source: A bright tick when the weather changes.
items.target: 当天气发生变化时，产生清脆的提示震动。

items.source: A clear tactical chime when a waypoint ping pin is placed on the terrain or map.
items.target: 当在地形或地图上放置路径点标记时，产生清晰明确的战术提示鸣响。

items.source: A continuous gait texture while moving — footfalls on foot, hoofbeats mounted.
items.target: 移动时产生持续的步态纹理——步行时的脚步踏击，骑乘时的马蹄踏鸣。

items.source: A continuous texture underwater that intensifies as your breath depletes.
items.target: 水下产生的持续材质纹理，并随着剩余呼吸消耗而逐渐增强。

items.source: A falling pulse when the radial menu closes.
items.target: 当轮盘菜单关闭时，产生渐弱的震动脉冲。

items.source: A firm impact as your flight path mount touches down at your destination.
items.target: 当飞行路线坐骑降落在目的地着陆时，产生稳健的撞击震动。

items.source: A gentle, steady texture for the duration of a taxi flight.
items.target: 乘坐飞行坐骑的整个飞行期间，产生平缓稳定的材质纹理。

items.source: A heartbeat-like warning when your breath meter drops below a quarter, underwater.
items.target: 在水下当呼吸条降至四分之一以下时，产生类似心跳的警示震动。

items.source: A heavy, suffocating thud each time you take damage from drowning underwater.
items.target: 在水下每次受到溺水伤害时，产生沉重窒息的沉闷重击。

items.source: A light tick the instant you jump or start a Skyriding ascend.
items.target: 起跳或开始驭龙术/天空飞跃升空的瞬间，产生轻微的提示跳动。

items.source: A light tick when you land after a short fall or jump.
items.target: 跳跃或短距离下落着陆时，产生轻微的提示跳动。

items.source: A near-subliminal sense of being in water, for as long as you are — buoyancy rather than effort.
items.target: 只要处于水中，就会产生一种若有若无的水体存在感——是浮力而非划水做功。

items.source: A sharp impact when you land after a long fall.
items.target: 长距离高处跌落着陆时，产生剧烈的撞击震动。

items.source: A soft release tick when stepping out of auto-attack melee range of your target.
items.target: 脱离目标的自动攻击近战范围时，产生柔和的脱离提示跳动。

items.source: A soft tick when you dismount.
items.target: 下马时产生柔和的提示跳动。

items.source: A strong impulse of thrust as your flight path mount launches into the air.
items.target: 当飞行路线坐骑腾空起飞时，产生强劲的推力脉冲。

items.source: A subtle tick when stepping within auto-attack melee range of your target.
items.target: 进入目标的自动攻击近战范围时，产生微妙的提示跳动。

items.source: A very light tick when a friendly unit comes under your reticle.
items.target: 当友方单位进入你的准星时，产生极轻微的提示跳动。

items.source: A very light tick when something you could attack comes under your reticle.
items.target: 当可攻击目标进入你的准星时，产生极轻微的提示跳动。

items.target: 在海中游泳时产生非对称的海洋重力涌浪与海岸波浪起伏。

items.source: Base strength of rain drops on the light motor.
items.target: 轻震马达上雨滴击打的基础强度。

items.source: Breath texture stays completely silent (no ambient, no gasps) while breath remaining is above this — requested live 2026-09-16 as ~70% breath remaining, well before real danger, so the calm bradycardic heartbeat has room to establish before anything steepens.
items.target: 当剩余呼吸高于此阈值时，呼吸纹理保持完全静音（无环境水声，无喘息）——根据 2026-09-16 实机测试需求设为约 70% 剩余呼吸，远早于真正危险发生之前，以便在心率陡增之前让平缓的心动过缓心跳有足够铺垫空间。

items.source: Continuous atmospheric vibration matching the current weather (rain, snow, sandstorm) and its intensity.
items.target: 匹配当前天气（雨、雪、沙尘暴）及其强度的持续环境氛围震动。

items.source: Cycles per second, if you turn the swell on below. 0.15 is roughly one slow rise and fall every seven seconds. Deliberately far slower than the stroke rate above — two layers sharing a frequency read as one sensation instead of two.
items.target: 若在下方开启涌浪，此项设定每秒周期数。0.15 约等于每 7 秒一次缓慢的起伏升降。刻意设定为远慢于上方的划水频率——若两层触感共享相同频率，会被感知为一个整体而非两个独立的层次。

items.source: Effort only, routed by default to the heavy motor alongside "In water", so the two merge into natural fluid resistance with clean glide coast-down between strokes. Turn on "Own motor" only if you want the stroke isolated on the high-frequency motor. Scales on your speed relative to your own swim speed, so it is silent while floating.
items.target: 仅划水做功，默认与“水中浮力”一同路由至重震马达，使二者融合成自然的流体阻力，并在每次划水之间伴随清爽的滑行减速感。仅当你希望将划水感隔离至轻震马达时，才开启“独立马达”。根据相对于自身游泳速度的移速缩放，因此静止漂浮时保持静音。

items.source: How long this motor takes to fall back toward silence. Too high and consecutive taps blur into one buzz; too low and sustained textures sound chopped. 0.028 reproduces the engine's old behaviour at 60fps.
items.target: 该马达衰减回静音所需的时间。数值过高会导致连续轻击粘连成一片蜂鸣；数值过低会导致持续纹理听起来断断续续。0.028 可在 60fps 下复现引擎此前的行为特性。

items.source: Multiplies gait strength while mounted, on top of the racial mount's own weight. A kodo is already heavier than a hawkstrider before this touches it.
items.target: 在种族坐骑自身重量的基础上，倍增骑乘时的步态强度。在此参数生效前，科多兽的体感本就比陆行鸟更沉重。

items.source: New setups enable casting, crafting, low-health and breath effects. Other effects start off; your saved choices are kept.
items.target: 新配置将启用施法、制造、低生命值与呼吸效果。其他效果默认关闭；你已保存的自定义选择将予以保留。

items.source: No legacy event for this one — it arrives only through the interaction manager, so it is silent if this client does not send that. Untested.
items.target: 该事件无传统旧版事件对应——仅通过交互管理器送达，因此若当前客户端未发送该事件则保持静音。未测试。

items.source: Occurrence only, deliberately near-subliminal so it doesn't compete with "Levelled up". No size scaling: the amount would need UnitXP diffing and isn't worth the bookkeeping for a cue this quiet.
items.target: 仅单次触发事件，刻意调校为若有若无以避免与“升级”提示相冲突。无数值缩放：计算经验量需要对比 UnitXP 差异，对于如此轻微静音的提示而言不值得增加此项性能开销。

items.source: Off by default, layers with "Low health" rather than replacing it — same relationship as breathWarning/breathTexture. Same mechanism and same fullscreen-panel caveat as lowHealthWarning above. The shape itself is a code-level switch (Modules/Health.lua's HEARTBEAT_STYLE: smooth glow, flash-synced lub-dub, or an independently-timed lub-dub), not exposed here — flash-synced won out by feel. The knock's own gap/duration/intensity used to be four sliders here; fixed as plain constants in Modules/Health.lua once this exact combination was confirmed to feel right (2026-09-15).
items.target: 默认关闭，与“低生命值”叠加生效而非取而代之——类似于 breathWarning 与 breathTexture 的关系。机制与上述 lowHealthWarning 完全相同，并受相同的全屏面板限制。震动形态本身是代码级开关（Modules/Health.lua 的 HEARTBEAT_STYLE：平滑发光、闪烁同步的“怦-怦”心跳，或独立计时的“怦-怦”心跳），未在此处公开——根据体感最终采用闪烁同步方案。敲击的心跳间隔/持续时间/强度曾在此处设有四个滑块；在确认该组合体感完美后，已直接固化为 Modules/Health.lua 中的常量（2026-09-15）。

items.source: Off by default, layers with "Low on breath" rather than replacing it.
items.target: 默认关闭，与“呼吸不足”叠加生效而非取而代之。

items.source: One cue for all four edges (top, bottom, left, right), observed via SmartNavigation's directional edge callbacks while keeping button selection isolated via polling to prevent execution taint. Standard default is off.
items.target: 四条边缘（上、下、左、右）通用的单一提示，通过 SmartNavigation 的方向边缘回调监测，同时按钮选择通过轮询隔离以防止执行污染。标准默认设置处于关闭状态。

items.source: Only audible if "Riding a flight path" is also enabled on its own tab.
items.target: 仅当其所属标签页中的“乘坐飞行路线”同时启用时方可感知。

items.source: Only while mounted
items.target: 仅限骑乘时

items.source: Overall strength of each footfall before speed and state scaling.
items.target: 在根据移速和状态缩放之前，每次脚步踏击的整体强度。

items.source: PLAYER_SOFT_ENEMY_CHANGED, an occurrence-only event with no payload at all — there is nothing here to come back secret. Fires on the soft target changing, which is not the same as actually targeting something; that's still "Target changed" on the Target & Focus page. Expect this to fire often while sweeping the camera through a crowd.
items.target: PLAYER_SOFT_ENEMY_CHANGED，无任何附加参数的纯单次触发事件——此处没有任何涉密数据。在软目标发生变更时触发，这与实际选定目标不同；实际选定目标仍由“目标与焦点”页面上的“目标已变更”负责。在人群中快速转动镜头时，预计该事件会频繁触发。

items.source: Pans left and right footfalls across the Low and High motors so the stride walks across your hands. Turn off for centered dual-motor footfalls.
items.target: 将左右脚步踏击声像在重震与轻震马达之间平移分配，使步伐在双手掌心间交替踏过。关闭此项可获得居中的双马达同步脚步震动。

items.source: Personal damage clutter, footsteps, weather, world dialogs
items.target: 自身伤害干扰、脚步声、天气、世界对话

items.source: Ping placed
items.target: 已放置标记

items.source: Present whether or not you are moving, and it does not read your speed at all, so it keeps working while speed comes back as a secret value. Drives the SLOW motor, whose large mass is what buoyancy actually feels like, leaving the sharp one to "Swimming resistance" — so the two never collide. Floating gives you this alone.
items.target: 无论移动与否均持续存在，且完全不读取移动速度，因此即便速度作为机密值返回时也能正常工作。主要驱动慢速重震马达（其较大的转动惯量能真实模拟水体浮力），将轻快马达留给“游泳阻力”——使二者互不冲突。静止漂浮时仅呈现此项效果。

items.source: Puts the stroke on the sharp motor. Turn off (recommended) to route swimming resistance to the heavy motor alongside ambient water, producing deep hydrodynamic drag instead of high-frequency motor buzz.
items.target: 将划水动作分配至轻震马达。关闭此项（推荐）可将游泳阻力与环境水体一同路由至重震马达，营造深沉的水动力拖拽感，而非高频马达的蜂鸣感。

items.source: Rain intensity
items.target: 降雨强度

items.source: Rate of rain drops and micro-flutter patter.
items.target: 雨滴敲击与细密颤动轻拍的频率。

items.source: Reads C_Weather.GetCurrentWeather() in WoW Forever. Modulates micro-flutter for rain, slow crystalline drift for snow, and dual rumble for sandstorms, scaled by weather intensity.
items.target: 读取 WoW Forever 中的 C_Weather.GetCurrentWeather()。根据天气强度按比例调制：下雨表现为细密微颤，下雪表现为缓慢晶莹飘荡，沙尘暴表现为双马达深沉轰鸣。

items.source: Restricts the gait to mounted travel, where a sustained texture is most welcome. Turn off to feel your own footsteps too — try it before leaving it on.
items.target: 将步态限制为骑乘行进，在骑乘状态下持续的材质纹理体感最为舒适。关闭此项亦可感知自身的步行脚步声——在决定常开之前不妨先试用体验。

items.source: Rhythmic footsteps on foot and hoofbeat cadence while mounted, weighted by armor class.
items.target: 徒步时的节奏性脚步与骑乘时的马蹄踏鸣韵律，并根据护甲类型赋予不同重量感。

items.target: 乘坐飞行路线

items.target: 水下呼吸量偏低时逐渐增强的心跳脉冲，随着呼吸耗尽而加快并加剧。

items.source: Same fall-duration proxy as "Landed", just a higher threshold and a heavier mode.
items.target: 与“着陆”采用相同的下落时长估算机制，仅具有更高的触发阈值和更厚重的震动模式。

items.source: Sandstorm / Gale intensity
items.target: 沙尘暴 / 大风强度

items.source: Scored by how long you were airborne, not by fall damage — that number is unreadable. A short hop stays silent below the threshold.
items.target: 根据滞空时间长短进行评估，而非根据坠落伤害——该数值无法直接读取。短距离小跳低于阈值时保持静音。

items.source: Second-harmonic Stokes drift shaping. 0.0 is a pure symmetric sine wave; higher values create a sharp, steep crest and an elongated trough, matching real fluid gravity waves.
items.target: 二阶谐波斯托克斯漂移波形塑造。0.0 为纯对称正弦波；数值越高会产生尖锐陡峭的波峰与拉长平缓的波谷，贴近真实的流体重力波。

items.source: Seconds between drowning damage pulses while submerged with zero breath.
items.target: 潜水呼吸归零后，溺水伤害脉冲之间的间隔秒数。

items.source: Simulates real fluid swell physics via harmonic wave synthesis: a slow, rhythmic rise into a steep wave crest, followed by a gentle glide into the trough. Driven primarily by the heavy slow motor with high-motor crest spray at peak amplitude. Automatically targets ocean and coastal waters unless configured to run in all swimming water.
items.target: 通过谐波合成模拟真实流体涌浪物理效果：缓慢、有节奏地升至陡峭波峰，随后平稳滑入波谷。主要由慢速重震马达驱动，在振幅峰值处辅以轻震马达呈现浪花飞溅感。默认自动针对海洋与沿海水域生效，除非配置为在所有游泳水体中生效。

items.source: Strength at full swimming speed. Replaces the old swimLowPeak/swimHighPeak pair, which were blended with max() and were therefore algebraically one knob: the smaller never did anything.
items.target: 全速游泳时的震动强度。替代了过去的 swimLowPeak/swimHighPeak 组合，旧方案通过 max() 混合，代数上实际等同于单个旋钮：较小的那个数值完全不起作用。

items.source: Strength of abrasive gusts and heavy windstorms.

items.source: Strokes per second at full speed. Swimming faster strokes faster, not merely harder — the old version only ever changed amplitude.
items.target: 全速游泳时每秒的划水次数。游得更快时划水频率亦会提升，而非仅仅增强力度——旧版本此前仅改变了震动幅度。

items.source: Tempo at zero breath remaining — the panic end of the climb, reached only in the final stretch below lateBreathThreshold.

items.source: Tempo from dangerStartThreshold down to midBreathThreshold — a real bradycardic rate (the diving reflex actually slows the heart at first, requested live 2026-09-16), not an elevated one.
items.target: 从 dangerStartThreshold 降至 midBreathThreshold 期间的节奏——真实的心动过缓速率（潜水反射起初实际上会减慢心率，根据 2026-09-16 实机测试需求调整），而非心率上升。

items.source: The catch-all. Enum.PlayerInteractionType has 81 values and most are retail systems a classic-shaped roster never meets; anything unmapped lands here rather than being silent, which also means a window type added to the client later is covered with no change to Pulse. Turn it on with /pulse debug to find out which types your client actually sends. Untested.
items.target: 通用兜底项。Enum.PlayerInteractionType 拥有 81 个枚举值，其中大多数属于经典旧世框架从未涉及的正式服系统；任何未明确映射的类型都会归入此处而非保持静音，这也意味着后续客户端若新增窗口类型，无需修改 Pulse 即可自动覆盖。可通过 /pulse debug 开启以查明你的客户端实际发送了哪些类型。未测试。

items.source: The effort of pulling yourself through water — a rhythmic hydrodynamic stroke that quickens and hardens with movement speed.
items.target: 在水中划水前行的做功感——一种有节奏的流体水动力划击，随着移动速度加快而变得更为迅捷与坚实。

items.source: The fallback for any character with no rule of its own — including characters you have not logged into yet. Set this to the profile you mostly want, then override the handful of characters that differ.
items.target: 没有任何专属规则的角色的兜底配置——包含你尚未登录过的角色。建议将其设为你最常用的主要配置文件，随后只需为少数特殊角色单独覆盖规则即可。
